name: Crimson Expedition raises Bloodbolt's critical strike chance (#1382)
contract: Crimson Expedition 523727's tooltip is "Increases the critical strike chance of your Bloodbolt, Blood Shards, and Aortic Assault by $s1%", with $s1 = 10 (BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1). Its single effect is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 4194306, 0): word 1 bit 22 selects Aortic Assault 806502 and word 1 bit 1 selects Blood Shard 504115, but Bloodbolt is word 1 bit 17 (131072) and that bit is absent, so the first spell the tooltip names received nothing. The eight Bloodbolt records (578304, 578305, 804685, 806928-806932) are the only family-26 rows carrying SpellFamilyFlags (0, 131072, 0). The discriminating assertion is the crit modifier on Bloodbolt 578305: 0 on today's tree, 10 with the missing bit added. The Aortic Assault and Blood Shard assertions already pass and guard against the widening reaching too far.
